_source: Git-tracked fallback for curia-suggestion-review's 'genuinely uncertain, ask a human' path. Added 2026-09-04, at explicit user request, after diagnosing the real reason Curia Command's live db (the intended destination — see that tab's own 'How an agent flags something uncertain here' panel) was staying empty: writing to the Artifact tool's db from this job's actual execution environment (a headless RemoteTrigger cloud session) triggers an interactive permission prompt ('Claude wants to edit this artifact's data') that nobody is present to answer — confirmed directly from a real run's session log (get_run_log on session_01KQaCpzGQfZsQASZNnSfDWK, 2026-09-04), not guessed. Reading Curia Command's db works fine unattended (read_db never prompts); only writes are blocked. Git writes (this file) already work perfectly reliably for this job — every venue/district promotion has always gone through git — so uncertain items land here instead, and get synced into Curia Command's real Pending Review tab by a human (or an interactive Claude Code session, which doesn't hit the same wall) during a normal check-in. Once synced, an entry's `syncedToPortal` flips to true; the agent should skip re-syncing (but still re-check `status`) on later runs.

items.reason: Two independent listing sites (Tripadvisor and HappyCow) both explicitly mark King Street Kitchen as CLOSED, and a local Facebook group post laments its closing.
items.researchNotes: Web search 2026-09-05: Tripadvisor's own listing title reads 'King Street Kitchen Knutsford - CLOSED' and HappyCow's review page is headed 'CLOSED: King Street Kitchen - Knutsford Restaurant'. A Facebook group post ('Sad to see King Street Kitchen close, need to make sure...') corroborates. Could not independently confirm an exact closure date or find a same-site successor business. The venue's own Instagram/Facebook pages were not conclusively checked for a contradicting recent 'still open' post, so this is flagged for a human glance rather than auto-removed, per the closure-audit rule.

items.reason: A Tripadvisor review reports arriving to find Riva Bar & Restaurant (Hale) closed and 'appears to have closed down' — the second independent closure signal on this venue, after 2026-09-04's dietary/pet research pass already flagged 'recent reviews suggest it closed a few weeks ago' without acting on it.
items.researchNotes: Web search 2026-09-05, following up on the open flag left in docs/data/venues.json's own _dietaryPetSource note (2026-09-04: 'recent reviews suggest it closed a few weeks ago', not acted on at the time). A Tripadvisor review of Riva Bar & Restaurant, 4 Cecil Road, Hale describes turning up to a closed restaurant. Other listings (the venue's own site rivahale.uk, OpenTable-style aggregators) still show it as a going concern with normal weekly closed days (Mon/Tue), so the signal is real but not unanimous — exactly the kind of borderline case this queue exists for rather than an auto-removal.

items.reason: alderleyedge.com's own headline ('The times they are a-changin as The Yard closes cafe and shop') confirms the greengrocer/bakery/juice-bar Front Yard that this venue's reason text describes has closed — the second flag on this venue, after 2026-09-04's dietary/pet pass already raised it without acting.
items.researchNotes: Web search 2026-09-05, following up on the open flag left in docs/data/venues.json's own _dietaryPetSource note (2026-09-04: 'one source... describes its cafe/shop as having closed at some point', not acted on at the time). alderleyedge.com's own article confirms the Front Yard's organic bakery, artisan butchers and greengrocers — the exact 'market-hall energy' this venue's reason text is built on — closed as a cafe/shop; the Back Yard creative/events space may continue separately, so this reads as the venue's real character changing rather than the whole site vanishing, still a call for a human rather than an auto-removal.
